content.value_statement: Teams miss early warning signs when metrics live across finance, product, customers, and team systems. This skill structures health checks, anomaly reviews, digests, alerts, and decision simulations for AI-assisted business monitoring.
actual_capabilities: Defines 13 business health domains with weighted scoring guidance.
Creates daily, weekly, and monthly health digest structures.
Reviews anomalies across financial, customer, product, team, and market metrics.
Models decision tradeoffs across runway, team, product, and growth domains.
Provides alert threshold and trend analysis prompt patterns.
limitations: Does not include live API integrations or automated data ingestion.
Does not train or run machine learning models for anomaly detection.
Requires accurate business metrics supplied by the user or workspace.
Provides advisory analysis and does not replace financial, legal, or HR review.

use_cases.title: Run a founder health check
use_cases.description: Summarize runway, revenue, churn, team risk, product quality, and next actions before a leadership meeting.

use_cases.title: Prepare an operating digest
use_cases.description: Turn weekly metrics into domain scores, anomalies, working areas, and recommended focus for the next week.

use_cases.title: Test a strategic decision
use_cases.description: Compare the business impact of a hire, feature push, customer loss, or funding plan before taking action.

prompt_templates.title: Daily health check
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a daily business health check from these metrics. Show red flags, green flags, key numbers, and one recommended action.

prompt_templates.title: Weekly domain digest
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a weekly digest across finance, customer, product, team, market, and operations. Include domain scores, anomalies, trends, and next week focus.

prompt_templates.title: Anomaly investigation
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate this anomaly using the cognitive twin framework. Explain likely causes, affected domains, severity, monitoring needs, and corrective actions.

prompt_templates.title: Decision simulation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced scenario modeling before a major decision.
prompt_templates.prompt: Simulate this decision over 3, 6, and 12 months. Compare base case, upside case, downside case, affected domains, health score changes, and decision criteria.

output_examples.input: Weekly metrics show revenue up, engagement down, and team satisfaction lower than last month.
output_examples.output: A weekly digest with domain scores, product and team anomalies, likely causes, strategic implications, and three focused actions for next week.

output_examples.input: We may hire an engineering manager while runway is eight months.
output_examples.output: A decision simulation comparing runway cost, product quality gains, team impact, investor readiness, and conditions that support waiting or hiring.

output_examples.input: Set alert thresholds for churn, runway, uptime, and customer concentration.
output_examples.output: A threshold plan with trigger points, severity labels, review cadence, and suggested actions for each monitored metric.

best_practices: Provide current metrics, comparison periods, and targets for each domain.
Ask for assumptions and confidence levels when forecasts drive decisions.
Review recommendations with accountable owners before changing operations.
anti_patterns: Do not treat example scores as benchmarks for every company.
Do not use simulated outcomes as the only basis for financial decisions.
Do not request real-time monitoring unless the required data is available.

faq.question: What does this skill monitor?
faq.answer: It monitors business health across finance, customer, product, team, market, operations, and related strategic domains.

faq.question: Does it connect to live business systems?
faq.answer: No. The documented version uses user-provided metrics and templates, not automated API integrations.

faq.question: Can it detect anomalies?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps compare metrics against expected ranges and explains possible causes, severity, and actions.

faq.question: Can it replace a board report?
faq.answer: No. It can draft operating insights, but leaders should verify numbers and adapt the report for governance needs.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide recent revenue, churn, runway, customer, product, team, market, and operating metrics with targets or prior periods.
